summary: When a green-slime-form hero successfully slimes a monster that cures itself with a fire scroll, JavaScript consumes the scroll but skips the resulting fire explosion. C calls explode() from muse_unslime(); the skipped blast causes the downstream inventory-destruction RNG and screen mismatch.

source.branch: In muse_unslime(), when the monster uses SCR_FIRE and is not confused, C calculates the scroll damage, consumes the scroll, calls explode(mon->mx, mon->my, -11, dmg, SCROLL_CLASS, by_you ? -EXPL_FIERY : EXPL_FIERY), then sets dmg to zero because explode() applied the effects.
callers: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slim() -> muse.c:munslime() -> muse.c:muse_unslime() for a successful hero slime attack against a monster that can cure sliming with SCR_FIRE
dependencies: explode.c:explode() (already implemented in js/explode.js; applies the blast, inventory destruction, damage, and screens)

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/muse.c:3158-3167: the unconfused SCR_FIRE arm consumes the scroll, calls explode() at the monster coordinates with type -11 and SCROLL_CLASS, and sets dmg to zero afterward.
js/muse.js:3445-3455: the same arm consumes SCR_FIRE but currently calls note_unported('explode.c explode') instead of invoking the blast; its later dmg=0 assignment therefore omits the C effects.

js/explode.js:411-460 and 560-690: explode() already accepts the scroll class, derives AD_FIRE from type -11, and processes monsters and the hero, including destroy_items(), armor burning, damage, and rendering.

challenges/cases/v66/v66-monster-fire-scroll-cure-action9.recipe.session.json: the hero becomes a green slime, acquires a hostile ogre holding the fire-scroll stack, and performs a forced contact attack; the ogre then reads the scroll to cure sliming.

challenges/evaluations/admission-979a3f3967638748dc19cf8b6ea8851736ade63e-v66.json: the saved baseline first mismatches at step 532, with C rn2(5)=2 at zap.c:5998 and JS rn2(3)=2; the C RNG call is downstream of the omitted explode() call, so zap.c:destroy_items is not the first-cause owner.
